content: Augmenting DB with same amount of samples from structured tasks (HA) and from conversational speech (FP) brings about similar performance. Doubling the initial amount of control data with data from a different structured task (HA, HAFP) results in an increase of up to 9% in F1 scores.
qasper_evidence_text: Augmenting DB with same amount of samples from structured tasks (HA) and from conversational speech (FP) brings about similar performance. Doubling the initial amount of control data with data from a different structured task (HA, HAFP) results in an increase of up to 9% in F1 scores.
